verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine for MoE models, with an OpenAI-compatible server, one-shot chat, and on-device apps. The axis applies because its desktop and mobile apps could plausibly analyze user data. However, nothing in the evidence shows the product generating insights or suggestions from a user's own data. Generic chat completion is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
